name: AWR 容量规划诊断
description: 基于 AWR 历史数据进行趋势预测和容量规划。分析 CPU/I/O/内存/存储的使用趋势，预测何时需要扩容。常见问题包括数据保留期不足、趋势解读不当、未考虑业务增长。

root_causes.name: AWR 保留期不足
root_causes.desc: 默认 8 天保留期不足以做月度或季度趋势分析。建议至少 35 天。

root_causes.name: 未建立资源使用基线
root_causes.desc: 没有正常负载的基准数据，无法判断趋势是否异常。

root_causes.name: 未考虑业务增长
root_causes.desc: 线性外推不考虑业务计划（如新项目上线、促销活动）。

root_causes.name: 数据粒度不当
root_causes.desc: AWR 快照间隔过长丢失峰值细节。

oltp.desc: 关注 CPU 和连接数增长

olap.desc: 关注存储和 I/O 增长

step1_cpu_trend.sql: SELECT TRUNC(begin_interval_time) day, ROUND(AVG(value), 2) avg_cpu_pct, ROUND(MAX(value), 2) max_cpu_pct FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE s.metric_name = 'Host CPU Utilization (%)' AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - 30 GROUP BY TRUNC(begin_interval_time) ORDER BY day

step2_io_trend.sql: SELECT TRUNC(begin_interval_time) day, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Physical Read Total Bytes Per Sec' THEN value END)/1024/1024, 2) avg_read_mb_sec, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Physical Write Total Bytes Per Sec' THEN value END)/1024/1024, 2) avg_write_mb_sec FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE s.metric_name IN ('Physical Read Total Bytes Per Sec', 'Physical Write Total Bytes Per Sec') AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - 30 GROUP BY TRUNC(begin_interval_time) ORDER BY day

step3_storage_trend.sql: SELECT TRUNC(begin_interval_time) day, ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1024/1024/1024, 2) total_gb FROM dba_hist_tbspc_space_usage s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - 30 GROUP BY TRUNC(begin_interval_time) ORDER BY day

step4_session_trend.sql: SELECT TRUNC(begin_interval_time) day, ROUND(AVG(value), 0) avg_sessions, ROUND(MAX(value), 0) max_sessions FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE s.metric_name = 'Current Logons Count' AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - 30 GROUP BY TRUNC(begin_interval_time) ORDER BY day
